opening: I'm here for the pre-employment medical checkup that my prospective employer requires.
I bring up sputum when I cough.
I immigrated from Africa a month ago.
I used to work in a coal mine back home.

opening.text: I'm here for the pre-employment medical checkup that my prospective employer requires. I have a cough and I bring up sputum when I cough. I immigrated from Africa a month ago and used to work in a coal mine back home. I also smoke cigarettes.
